tools.name: summary
tools.description: Use when you need a short, sourced explanation of a topic, place, organization, product or concept: returns the Wikipedia article's lead section as plain text plus title, short description, thumbnail and original image, page URL, Wikidata ID and last-modified time, in any Wikipedia language (redirec

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use to find the right Wikipedia article before reading it: full-text search over one Wikipedia language edition, returning up to 20 results with title, plain-text snippet, page URL, word count and last edit time, ranked by relevance. Results are titles and snippets only; use /v1/summary for content.

tools.name: entity
tools.description: Use when you need structured, machine-readable facts rather than prose: give a Wikidata ID (Q95) or a name (resolved to the best-matching item) and get its label, description, aliases, Wikipedia link and up to ~50 curated properties with human-readable labels: instance of, country, location, coordin

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
